meta.title: Reading reminders for an event that does not exist crashes instead of "not found"

direct.expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly (404 or 422). Today EventGroup.find_by returns nil and authorize(nil, :show?) raises Pundit::NotDefinedError, which is not rescued (only NotAuthorizedError is, api_auth.rb:16) -> HTTP 500. A 500 here is the defect.
